svg.text: Step 2. π-MO ladders: look only at the two END lobes
S = ends have the same sign (on the same face); A = ends have opposite signs. ψ1, ψ3, ψ5 … are S; ψ2, ψ4, ψ6 … are A.
cation LUMO / radical SOMO / anion HOMO
Rule of thumb: count nodes. Even number of nodes (ψ1, ψ3 …) → S; odd number (ψ2, ψ4 …) → A. The middle lobes never decide W–H; only the ends form bonds.
Hückel coefficients; lobe size ∝ |c|. Sources: CM3121 L13 p.27; L14 p.10, 23; L16 p.22–25; Clayden 2e p.886.
